scenarios.scenario: Save changes to an existing part and reopen its sketch

scenario_steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open as a saved empty part in the MCAD Software
the user creates a planar sketch with a rectangular profile
the user finishes the sketch
the user presses Control+S
the existing document remains open without a Save As dialog
the user closes the document tab
the user opens the file-opening dialog in the same session
the user selects the saved part
the user opens the selected part
the model browser contains the sketch
the rectangular sketch profile is visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Toggle the preview picture controls before saving

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user clears Save Preview Picture
the preview source choices are hidden
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user selects Save Preview Picture again
the preview source choices reappear
the user chooses Active Window on Save
that preview source is selected
Active Component Iso View on Save is not selected
the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save
the user cancels the dialog
the unsaved part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Browse for a preview image and cancel the image chooser

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user chooses Import From File as the preview source
a browse control appears beside that option
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user chooses the browse control
an image file chooser opens above the Save As dialog
the user cancels the image file chooser
the Save As dialog remains open
Import From File remains selected
the preview area still displays a placeholder
the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save
the user cancels Save As
the unsaved part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Inspect file type choices when saving a part

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the user opens the file type list
the list offers the native part file type and an All Files filter

scenarios.scenario: Cancel closing a modified unsaved part

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane
the unsaved part containing that sketch is active
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
a save-changes prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel
the user chooses Cancel
the part remains active
its sketch remains in the model browser

scenarios.scenario: Cancel the first save requested while closing a part

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane
the unsaved part containing that sketch is active
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
the Save As dialog opens
the user cancels Save As
the part remains active
its sketch remains in the model browser
the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane
the unsaved modified part is active
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
the user opens the prompt-frequency list
the list offers always show, once per operation, suppress for this session and suppress permanently
the user dismisses the list without changing its selection
the user cancels the save-changes prompt
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Save a new modified part while closing it

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates a new unsaved metric part
the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane
the unsaved part containing that sketch is active
save-change prompts are configured to always show
another document is open
the proposed file name does not exist in the selected folder
the user closes the document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
the user accepts the proposed file name in Save As
the document closes
another open document becomes active
the user reopens the newly saved part in the same session
the part becomes active
its model browser contains the finished sketch

scenarios.scenario: Capture an active window preview before saving

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new empty part in the MCAD Software
Save Preview Picture is selected
the user chooses Active Window as the preview source
a capture control appears beside Active Window
the preview area displays a placeholder
the user activates the capture control
the preview area displays a dark image matching the empty workspace
the Save As dialog remains open
the user cancels the dialog
the unsaved part remains active
